name: Sparkline
description: A word-sized trend with no axes: a line, an area or bars, drawn as inline SVG. Every stack computes the same coordinates, so there is no chart library and no script. It's an image with a label stating the first and latest values; put the values themselves in a table or tooltip nearby.

livewire.name: sparkline
capabilities: Rendered on the server: wire:poll and Livewire updates redraw it with no script

props.name: data
props.description: The values, oldest first. Anything that isn't a finite number is skipped. Values that cross zero draw a dashed baseline at zero.

props.name: variant
props.description: A line with a dot on the latest value, the same with a soft fill below, or one bar per value (rect parts with data-part="bar"). The spec calls it kind. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: width
props.description: The width in px. Give sparklines in one column the same size and scale.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible label; {first}, {latest}, {min}, {max} and {count} are filled in from data. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Trend from {first} to {latest}' ).
props.a11y: Names the image, so the trend reads as its first and latest values.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { line: '…', dot: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The image: role=img, the label, and a viewBox of width × height. Its plot stays LTR in every direction (D-004).

parts.name: area
parts.description: The fill below the line, for the area variant.

parts.name: line
parts.description: The trend line, for the line and area variants.

parts.name: dot
parts.description: The latest value, for the line and area variants.

parts.name: baseline
parts.description: A dashed line at zero, when the values cross it.

requirements: role=img with a label that states the first and latest values, so the trend isn't only visual.
The values themselves are available nearby, in a table or tooltip.
One color for the whole trend, never up or down: the number beside it says that.
The line, dot and bars keep 3:1 against the surface (--apui-chart-1).
